articles.title: A Stormy Thanksgiving Across America
articles.summary: Thanksgiving storms brought floods, high winds, and power outages across the country, delaying flights and postponing the Macy's parade.

articles.title: Native Flavors Take Center Stage in Albuquerque
articles.summary: At Indian Pueblo Kitchen in Albuquerque, Native American dishes star on the menu, from blue corn enchiladas to biscochitos baked by Rita Toledo.

articles.title: A $1 Million Lottery Win, Then an Arrest Days Later
articles.summary: A Boston man won $1 million on a scratch ticket, then ICE said it arrested him days later; he remains in custody while his family asks for respect and empathy.
